QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` (`constant_time_impl.h:85-93`) wraps values in `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` so the compiler cannot prove a value and fold the mask back into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: Names the primitive as the barrier preventing the compiler from knowing/folding a value and locates it in constant_time_impl.h (library/ directory stated earlier).
